five of ten monoclonal anti-idiotype antibodies (mAB 2's) cross-reacted with all four mAbs 1's.

the five mAB2 antibodies are "internal image" anti-idiotypically, and that the anti-idiotype network is an effective means of eliciting antibodies that are reactive with the ligands of other antibodies.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation, characterization, and potential clinical applications of mAB1s and anti-idiotype antibodies.
the development of a monoclonal anti-kallidin antibody (mAb) which is specific for the kinin binding site of the kinin receptor.
the development of monoclonal antibodies (mABs) that can be used to detect and measure endogenous kinins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
these five mAB 2s are beta-type internal image anti-idiotypics.
the anti-idiotype antibodies obtained by immunizing with the mAB2s are internal image antibodies.
five mAB2 clones were obtained which were "internal image" type beta anti-idiotypies of mAB1s with a similar ligand binding specificity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
these mAB1s and mAB2s provide an excellent system for studying the molecular basis of antigen-antibody interactions, and for examining the molecular nature of the internal image concept.
the anti-idiotypically induced mAB2s are "internal image" antibodies which mimic the structure of kinin and are therefore useful in studying the structure and function of the kinin receptors.
the anti-idiotypically defined "internal image" is a "kinin-like molecule" and the anti-internal image is an anti-idiotypie anti-kinin antibody.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of a monoclonal antibody as the immunogen for anti-idiotypics is a very useful tool to generate internal image anti-idiotypies, and the use of a panel of monoclonal antibodies as immunogens is even more powerful.
it is possible to generate anti-idiotype antibodies that mimic ligand binding.
the mAB2s are able to interact, at similar affinity levels, with four different kinin binding mAB1s and are able to inhibit biotoxylated kallidin binding.
